title: Tail L1 + L2 block heads
summary: Long-running cast subscription that prints every new block on both chains.
audience: Anyone debugging block production timing or sequencer pacing.
description:
Subscribes via WebSocket to `eth_subscribe('newHeads')` on both the L1 and L2 RPC proxies. Prints a one-liner per block with number + hash + timestamp delta.

This runs **until you stop the playground** — there's no built-in stop button yet.

prerequisites.title: Both chains running
prerequisites.detail: Stops streaming if either RPC drops.
